interactables.text: The [Director] scribbles in a leather notebook. 'Missing bird + weeping star + locked mansion = [Emmy bait].' He doesn't look up.
The Sound Guy's mixing board hums. An [Audio Cable] runs from the back panel, disappears into the wall — heading in the direction of the [Living Room].
The [Sound Guy] is sweating. His name badge reads: '[D. Marsh].' He won't meet your eyes. His headphones are on but nothing's playing.
The Director's shot list for today. Items include: 'Rudebeak reaction shot — [CANCELLED].' Next to it, in red pen: '[BETTER WITHOUT HIM?]'

localDeductionSentence: The [Director] smelled an Emmy while 'D. Marsh' — the [Sound Guy] — kept his mixer running, an [Audio Cable] threading quietly through the wall toward the [Living Room].
